**html-shot 1.1.6 Changelog**

- Raised Node.js version requirement to ≥ 20.9 for better `sharp` compatibility; run now checks and exits with a helpful message if unmet.
- Metadata moved inside the `openclaw` section of SKILL.md for improved structure.
- Dropped the `tags` and duplicate `homepage` properties from SKILL.md.
- Removed `skill-card.md` as part of housekeeping.
- Minor documentation wording and formatting changes for clarity.

- Updated to version 1.1.5.
- Improved platform requirements and compatibility notes in documentation (SKILL.md).
- Clarified the install and usage instructions.
- Removed redundant file skill-card.md.
- Updated metadata to reflect ownership changes.

**html-shot 1.1.3 Changelog**

- Added trigger phrase (in description): now activates on "生成 og 图 / 社交卡片 / 网页截图 / HTML 转图片 / favicon / 应用图标".
- Improved install instructions: recommend `cd {SKILL_DIR} && npm install` for correct lockfile handling (especially if using symlinks).
- Clarified Playwright/Chromium disk usage details and corrected download size info.
- Expanded guidance for multi-language support in documentation.
- Removed `skill-card.md` file; updated READMEs for clarity.

html-shot 1.1.0 adds icon set generation, SVG support, and palette/bit-depth options.

- Adds `icons.mjs`: generate favicon and app icon sets from an HTML or SVG design.
- Input can now be an SVG file as well as HTML or URL.
- New options: `--palette` and `--colors` for paletted PNG outputs (2/4/16/256 colors).
- Example starter templates for favicon/app icon (`icon.example.html`) and README translations added.
- Documentation updated to reflect new features and entry points.
- Tag and description updated for icon and SVG support.
- Deprecated `skill-card.md` removed.

Initial release of html-shot – render HTML/CSS as high-fidelity static images.

- Turn any HTML (file or URL) into a pixel-perfect PNG, JPEG, or WebP image using Playwright (headless Chromium).
- Supports full CSS fidelity, CJK and emoji via system fonts—no custom font bundling required.
- Local assets (fonts, images, stylesheets) are resolved automatically, even if your dev server is down.
- Auto-detects output image size from the `body` by default; supports custom sizing, density, and cropping options.
- One-command install and clear error messages for missing dependencies; detailed guide for system requirements.
- Useful for generating/updating social preview cards (og:image), exporting design elements, or screenshotting pages and components.
